question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2023 Q5c(i/ii) — Electric Car Battery Charge and Resistance
question.text:
The battery in an electric car can be charged by passing a current of 11 A through it.

(i) Calculate the charge stored in the battery after 8 hours. (4 marks)

(ii) Calculate the resistance of the battery given that the voltage used is 220 V. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q5c(i) — Charge stored:

Q = It

Convert time: t = 8 h = 8 × 3600 = 28 800 s

Q = 11 × 28 800 = 316 800 C ≈ 3.17 × 10⁵ C

Q5c(ii) — Resistance:

R = V / I = 220 / 11 = 20 Ω

steps.label:
Given: I = 11 A | t = 8 h | V = 220 V
Formulas: Q = It | R = V/I (Ohm's law)
Calculate the charge stored after 8 hours. (4 marks)
Calculate the resistance of the battery. (3 marks)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Convert hours to seconds: t = 8 × 3600 = 28 800 s.

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Use Q = It, where I is current in amperes and t is time in seconds.
Use Ohm's law: R = V/I, where V is voltage in volts and I is current in amperes.
